lastResponse: Fastest way right now is to install from a local VSIX package. 1. Build the extension package - Open a terminal in E:\chat-commit - Run: npm install npm run compile npx @vscode/vsce package 2. Install the generated VSIX - In VS Code, open Command Palette - Run: Extensions: Install from VSIX... - Select the generated file (likely named session-control-0.1.0.vsix) 3. Reload VS Code - After install, reload window when prompted - Search for Session Control in Extensions to confirm it is installed Alternative for development-only testing (no install): - Press F5 in this repo to launch an Extension Development Host with Session Control loaded.
